critique: The render now has a denser orange ember field and clearly rises between t1 and t4, with a more convincing spread than the prior thin string. It still reads primarily as evenly soft glowing dots in a narrow, segmented vertical column rather than a cohesive turbulent ember plume. The particle scale remains small, and the motion/silhouette needs more lateral turbulence and a broader fiery core to better match a Rising Embers Smoke and Fire preset thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Increase the maximum particle size so the plume contains a more visible mix of bright, substantial embers instead of predominantly tiny dots.
Broaden the directional spread to break up the narrow central column and create a fuller rising plume silhouette.
Increase turbulence influence on particle position so the rising embers form a more organic, swirling fire-like path rather than separated clusters.
